depiction.primary_object: wireless signal fan with three radiating arcs and a dot
modifiers: closed padlock in the bottom-right corner
depiction.composition: single symbol with lower-right badge overlay

readings.meaning: Wi-Fi password or protected wireless network
network security or router encryption settings
locked or restricted internet access / parental controls

ambiguity: Easy to confuse with a plain Wi-Fi icon if the small padlock isn't noticed, or could mean either 'secure the network' or 'locked out of Wi-Fi'.

modifier_semantics.meaning: password-protected, secured, encrypted, or locked access

task_intents: get hotel or lounge Wi-Fi password

reasoning: Shows a standard Wi-Fi signal icon with a closed padlock badge, universally understood as a password-protected or secure wireless network. It fits tasks specifically about Wi-Fi passwords, guest network credentials, router encryption, or restricting wireless access, as well as general Wi-Fi setup tasks when no plain Wi-Fi icon is preferred.
